sources.title: Evicka/HanseLM-78M-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: HanseLM 78M Base is a small German-first causal language model and an experimental research preview. It was trained from scratch to study whether a hybrid attention/convolution architecture can learn useful German text representations under a roughly 1.5-billion-token compute budget.
